headline: Held three security deposit hearings on Buell Street and Hyde Street properties; board deliberated privately after adjourning.
summary: The board held hearings on three security deposit cases: 108 Buell Street, 21 Hyde Street Unit 3, and 21 Hyde Street Unit 1. Parties presented evidence and testimony in each case, and the hearings were closed. The board then deliberated in private after the meeting adjourned.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, September 14, 2026, 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
https://zoom.us/j/94770081322 
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Don Slish, Emma Ramirez-Richer, and Dylan Shelby 
Staff present: Shay Brunvand 
Meeting called to order at 06:32 PM 
1. Harper Gullage, Samara Gilhooley, Sarah Hunt, Ellie Wright, Kaelyn Langlois, and Brianna 
Martin (tenants); William Spencer (landlord) (security deposit case) re: 108 Buell Street 
Present were Casey Gullage, Ellie Wright, Lorene Eppley Hunt, Harper Gullage, Sarah Hunt, 
Samara Gilhooley, Brianna Martin, Kaelyn Langlois, Mikaela Spencer and William Spencer 
Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was closed.  
 
2. Benjamin Yurek (tenant); CASGVT, LLC c/o Rina Schneur (landlord) (security deposit case) re: 
21 Hyde Street, Unit 3 
Present were Benjamin Yurek, Rina Schneur, and Avner Schneur

closed.  
 
3. Jessie Rooney (tenant); CASGVT, LLC c/o Rina Schneur (landlord) (security deposit case) re: 21 
Hyde Street, Unit 1 
Present were Jessie Rooney, Rina Schneur, and Avner Schneur 
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:42 PM 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
